name: Quad Strider
description: Mech-style quadruped. Trot gait (diagonal pairs) for speed; two feet down is never statically stable, so it carries a Gyro Stabilizer.

proposal.summary: Fast travel walker. Trades static stability for ~3 b/s and pays for it with a Gyro Stabilizer (D6).
decisions: Gyro Stabilizer rated 160 mass·b: the trot needs up to 142 mass·b (steep hill, margin −1.13 b × 126 mass), so ~13% headroom. That adds up to ~285 SU on top of the 1070 SU drive.
Front knees bend back, hind knees bend forward, for a readable silhouette.
openQuestions: Stabilizer stress per torque (2 SU per mass·b) is a placeholder until the block exists. Is ~25% extra stress the right price for a trot?

Suspension at the default 2 Hz / ζ 0.7 lags enough on the 2-block ledge to push reach from 93% to 96% (fail). 4 Hz gets it back to 94% with slightly more bob. What leg spring gain will the mod actually reach?
Do we want automatic foothold search on by default?
